scope: Local macOS x86_64 weighted scalar sums and first-order ratios; two-input visible form, up to 16 linear inputs through the trusted command

reuse.decision: Adopt GTC propagation and Pint conversions; adapt the existing bounded Python job and Trrack history contracts. No replacement scientific or history engine.
reuse.distribution: External pinned Python environment; libraries are not bundled or installed on activation

validation.correlation: Finite, exact symmetry/unit diagonal/bounds, PSD eigenvalue tolerance 1e-12; no repair
validation.units: Compatible multiplicative units; explicit row semantics; ambiguous a.u. and offset units refused
validation.ratio_screen: abs(denominator) > 10 * standard_uncertainty; policy, not proof of linearization validity
validation.result: Finite output, analytical variance-budget consistency, node/data/spec/result hashes

numerical.scope: Analytical linear/correlated/three-input covariance, mixed units, singular correlation and exact inputs, ratio derivatives, shared identity, denominator screening, invalid values/matrices/units and underflow

controller.scope: Real GTC, row edits, settings undo, branch/save/reopen, missing rows/interpreter, trust, cancellation, stale successes/failures, failed retry persistence, stop and checksum

missing_library.check: Python without site packages refuses execution; no result JSON emitted

combination.scope: All provider host contracts pass together, including saved-fit Mathtext export. Measurement results are not part of publication bundles; simultaneous active numerical job UI interactions and combined LaTeX export not newly qualified.

corrections: Host tests use native Save All before closing editors; direct provider writes do not clear the editor dirty state.
Re-enable the second source selector when shared input identity is switched off.
Reject ambiguous arbitrary-unit placeholders instead of allowing Pint to interpret a.u. as an unrelated unit expression. Only the new generated synthetic example uses explicit volts.
Return linear outputs in the first input unit while normalizing calculations internally.
Store measurement settings as undoable data state rather than latest global journal settings.
Obsolete failures cannot mask a newer result after reopening; failed retries do not silently show old successes.
qualification_notes: Initial cold concurrent numerical startup reached the bounded 30-second deadline; dedicated-environment rerun passed. No cold-start performance claim.

Native focus and Electron webview animation-frame stability affected automation. Tests bring the editor forward, use pointer clicks and verify resulting state. No scripted DOM click substitutes for the tested buttons.
UI assertions wait for changed measurement content as well as completion to avoid accepting the previous result.
limitations: No Monte Carlo, general GUM conformity, coverage intervals or finite degrees of freedom
No arbitrary expressions, offset units, multi-output covariance or shared identities across separate measurement definitions
No propagation of fitted-parameter uncertainty or measurement-result publication
Python environment remains external; 30-second cancellable job deadline and bounded I/O
Explicit save required; automatic unsaved crash recovery excluded
Other platforms, packaged binaries and large-data performance unqualified
